title: Kay's GeoHub
text:
Geospatial analytics supports decision making and policy planning by providing insights derived from geographically referenced data. This includes the use of data wrangling, spatial statistics and spatial data visualisation technique.
This website serves as an archive for course assignments for the course ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Application, taken in August 2026.
